usage_note: Small task, well under turn cap.
open_questions: Economy-designer: add to data/balance.json values: storage_capacity (code default 100), storage_refill (5 per commodity per cycle), storage_start (1.0 fraction). I did not edit data/*.json per hard rule; code defaults apply until added.
T56: buy orders should call storage.add(key,c,n), sell orders storage.remove(key,c,n); planet key via Storage.planet_key(i). Full/empty checks: is_full/is_empty.
handoff: New game/storage.gd: stock per container and commodity, one shared capacity, slow per-cycle self-refill (tick called in main._end_cycle after route settlement). rating(key,c)/planet_rating(i,c) gives 0-5 (5 full, any stock >=1). Containers are string keys ('planet:<i>'); capacity_of()/refill_of() take the key, so a later 'system:<n>' space storage is a drop-in. Saved under 'storage' in the autosave; old saves get fresh stock. Saturation untouched. No UI. Headless check loads with no script errors (only sandbox log-file errors).

details.api: add, remove, amount, space, is_full, is_empty, rating, planet_rating, tick, to_dict, from_dict
